tei:div.tei:p: "] "!#༄༅// mnga' bdag yab sras thugs dam rgyun gyi nyams len zab pa skor bdun gyi phrin las byang bu bzhugs so//

na mo gu ru dhe wa ḍā ki nī yai hūm̐/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs mchog dpal// gcig tu bsdus te 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa// gcig chog rgyal po pad+ma gu ru la// snying nas skyabs mchi rjes su bzung du gsol// sangs rgyas sku dngos pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis// yang zab bskyed rdzogs kun gyi bcud phyungs nas// mnga' bdag yab sras chos rgyal la gsungs pa'i// thugs dam zab pa'i rgyun khyer gdams pa yi// las byang cho ga'i rim pa mdor bsdus zhig /yi ger dgod ces dad dang ldan pa yis// yang yang bskul bas zur tsam bris pa 'dis// ma gyur 'gro ba sems can ma lus pa// tshe 'dir zung 'jug 'od gsal brnyes gyur nas// 'gro kun srid mtsho sgrol ba'i don byed shog /'di la nyes pa cung zad mchis pa rnams// chos bdag bka' srung tshogs la bzod par gsol// de la mdor bsdus sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum du bsdus te lag len yi ger 'god pa la/ gzhung bzhin dkyil 'khor rdzas dang mchod pa bsham// de nas rang nyid bde ba'i stan la 'dug /lus sems khong klod skyabs yul gsal gdab la// dang po skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ na mo/ rtsa gsum kun 'dus gu ru rje// bdag dang ma gyur sems can rnams// 'di nas byang chub snying po'i bar// rtag par skyabs kyis rjes bzung gsol// bdag gis rtsa gsum lha tshogs bsgrub// gang de'i dge ba ma lus pa/ khams gsum sems can thams cad rnams// rang byung sangs rgyas thob par shog /hrīḥ rtsa gsum bla ma gshegs su gsol// dgyes pa'i gdan bzhugs gus phyag 'tshal// phyi nang gsang gsum mchod pas mchod// nyams sgrib bshags la rjes yi rang*// chos 'khor bskor zhing gzhan don bzhugs// dge tshogs 'gro bsngo yang dag gi /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par shog / de nas bgegs la gtor ma gtang ba ni/ hūm̐ hrīḥ 'bru gsum byin rlabs gtor ma 'dis// log 'dren bgegs tshogs tshims gyis la// rang rang so so'i gnas nyid du// skad cig nyid la phyir dengs shig

/hūm̐/ nga ni gtum drag khro bo'i sku /che mchog rdo rje gro bo lod// sku las khro chung me 'od 'phro// gdon bgegs bar chad mtshams bcad do// oṃ āḥhūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ badz+ra gu ru dhe ba ḍā ki nī badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mchod rdzas byin gyis brlab pa ni/ hūm̐/ chos rnams dmigs med stong pa'i ngang*// yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor dang*// raṃ las me yi dkyil 'khor steng*// kaṃ las thod sgyed rang byung snod// de nang 'bru gsum 'phro 'du las// phyi nang gsang gsum mchod tshogs dang*// sman gtor rak+ta gsang ba'i rdzas// ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho ni// nam mkha' rab 'byams khams gang bas// rtsa gsum mchod pa'i rdzas su gyur// oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛta/ ma hā rak+ta/ ba liṃ ta hrīḥṭhā/ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo kegan+dhe nai wid+ya shab+da sarba pū tsa ma hā pañtsa pū tsa/ ma hā bo dhi tsit+ta oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bshags pa ni/ hūm̐/ rtsa gsum thugs dam lha tshogs dgongs su gsol// bdag gis lus ngag yid gsum nyon mongs kyis// sdig pa mi dge ci dang ci bgyis pa// rtsa gsum thugs dam lha la bzod par gsol// mthol bshags bzod pa dam pa yar bzhes la// sgrib med tshangs pa'i dngos grub bstsal du gsol/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥpad+ma gu ru badz+ra sa man+ta sa tri lo ke shwa ra badz+ra lo ka ā yur+dz+nyā na dhā ki siṃ ha mu kha dzam+bha la sarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ/ sarba dharmāḥs ma ya hoḥs ma ya s+t+waṃ/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi ting 'dzin rnam gsum gzhal yas khang dang lha tshogs bskyed pa ni/ oṃ/ chos rnams dmigs med spros bral bsam yas las// sems can kun la khyab pa'i snying rje bsgom// stong nyid snying rje dbyer med phrin las las// rang rig hrīḥlas rang snang gzhal yas khang*// bkod pa rgyan rdzogs yongs rdzogs pho brang na// 'ja' tshon las grub 'od zer phreng ba 'phro// de dbus paṃ las 'dab drug pad+ma'i steng*// thabs shes nyi zla brtsegs pa'i gdan steng du// rang rig hrīḥlas don gnyis byas 'dus las// pad+ma gu ru sku mdog dkar dmar mdangs// zhabs gnyis skyil krung phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag steng*// mtshan ldan ka li 'chi med bdud rtsis bkang*// dbu la paṇa zhwa ber phod chos gos can// dmar ser ber phyam sum phrug snyan rgyan mdzes// snang la rang bzhin med pa'i sku ru gsal// phyogs bzhi steng 'og 'od lnga'i klong dkyil du// hūm̐ hrīḥhūm̐ hūm̐ hrīḥdzaṃ 'phro 'du las// shar du ngan song sbyong mdzad mi 'khrugs mthing*// lho phyogs spyan gzigs nam mkha'i rgyal po dkar// nub tu gtum drag rdo rje gro lod smug

/byang du ḍā ki seng ge'i gdong can mthing*// steng du tshe dpag dkar dmar mthing ga'i mdog /'og tu dzaṃ lha le brgan sku mdog can// zhi khro longs spyod rdzogs pa'i rgyan dang ldan// rang rang sku mdog phyag mtshan 'od du 'bar// 'khor du rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams// nam mkha'i sprin phung gtibs pa lta bur bsam// gnas gsum yi ge gsum gyis mtshan pa las// 'od 'phros rang bzhin gnas nas lha tshogs rnams// skar mda' lam la zhugs pa ji bzhin du// spyan drangs gnyis med thim pas rigs bdag ni// dbang bskur dbu brgyan dbyer med ngang du bsam// de nas byin dbab spyan 'dren ni/ hūm̐/ rang bzhin chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos kyang*// bdag blo mos pa'i tshul gyis spyan 'dren na// chos kyi dbyings las skur bzhengs 'dir gshegs la// dbang dang byin rlabs dus 'dir bstsal du gsol/ hūm̐/ pad+ma 'od kyi pho brang dam pa nas// rje btsun pad+ma gu ru gshegs su gsol// shar phyogs mngon par dga' ba'i zhing khams nas// bcom ldan mi 'khrugs rdo rje gshegs su gsol// lho phyogs ri bo ta la'i pho brang nas// 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang gshegs su gsol// dur khrod gsang chen rol pa'i pho brang nas// che mchog rdo rje gro lod gshegs su gsol// dur khrod bsil ba tshal gyi pho brang nas// dhā ki seng ge'i gdong can gshegs su gsol// nub phyogs bde ba can gyi pho brang nas// rigs bdag tshe dpag med pa gshegs su gsol// byang shar lcang lo can gyi pho brang nas// nor bdag gnod sbyin dzaṃ lha gshegs su gsol// gzhan yang dpa' bo ḍā ki shugs 'gro dang*// dam can srung ma'i tshogs rnams gshegs su gsol// oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥpad+ma gu ru badz+ra sa man+ta sa tri lo ke shwa ra badz+ra lo ka ā yur+dz+nyā na dhā ki siṃ ha mu kha dzam+bha la sa ma ya dzaḥ de nas bzhugs su gsol ba ni/

hūm̐/ skyon med thabs shes pad+ma nyi zla dang*// dar zab rin chen rnam lnga'i khri steng du// rtsa gsum thugs dam lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas// dgyes shing mi g.yo brtan par bzhugs su gsol// rtsa sngags sham bur/ badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan/ de nas phyag 'tshal ba ni/ hūm̐/ chos sku 'gyur med gdod ma gshis kyi mgon// longs spyod rdzogs sku mnyam yangs blo las 'das// gang la gang 'dul sprul skus don mdzad pa'i// rtsa gsum thugs dam lha la phyag 'tshal lo// rtsa sngags sham bur/ a ti pu hoḥ pra ti dza hoḥ de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐/ rtsa gsum thugs dam lha tshogs dkyil 'khor la// phyi nang snod bcud maṇ+ḍal mchod pa'i rdzas// gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya phun sum tshogs// sku lnga sgrub pa'i bdud rtsi a mṛ ta// dug gsum kun bsgral ma hā rak+ta dang*// zhal zas ro ldan gtor ma'i mchod pa dang*// lta sgom spyod gsum mnyam yangs mchod pa'i rdzas// ma tshang med pa dngos 'byor yid sprul te// sngags dang phyag rgya ting 'dzin byin brlabs nas// mchod pa'i lha mo yid 'ong mdzes pa yis// gar dang phyag rgya rab mdzes bsgyur nas su// rdo rje glu yis bskul te 'bul lags na// sku gsung thugs kyi dbyings su thim par mdzod// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub bstsal du gsol// rtsa sngags sham bur/ sman raka gtor gsum gyi sngags puṣ+pe nas ga ṇa gu h+ya pū tsa mu dra nīrti sarba pū tsa hoḥ de nas bstod pa ni/ hūm̐/ byin rlabs kun gyi 'byung gnas rin po che// dngos grub bdud rtsi dgos 'dod stsol mdzad pa// bar chad sel mdzad kun 'dus rin po che// pad+ma gu ru'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// ngan song sdug bsngal kun las skyob mdzad pa// me long ye shes dbyings su sbyor mdzad pa// mi 'khrugs rdo rje sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das// rdo rje'i rigs mchog mgon la phyag 'tshal bstod// 'gro kun snying rje brtse bas mi 'dor bar// thabs mkhas thugs rjes gzhan don mchog brtson pa// thugs rje chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs// nam mkha' rgyal po'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// log 'dren bdud dang dam sri tshar gcod cing*/

dug gsum dug lnga dbyings su sgrol mdzad pa// che mchog dbang drag rdo rje gro lod sku /gtum drag 'jigs byed dpal la phyag 'tshal bstod// dgra bgegs byad ma bud shing nyer 'tshe'i tshogs// bskyed rdzogs rig sngags drag pos sreg mdzad pa// siṃ ha mu kha log 'dren yongs kyi gshed// ḍā ki yongs kyi gtso la phyag 'tshal bstod// rgyal ba'i gsung mchog pad+ma dbang gi lha// 'gyur med sku brnyes tshe bcud kun gyi dpal// bcom ldan mgon po ye shes tshe dpag med// gsung mchog rigs kyi bdag la phyag 'tshal bstod// dgos 'dod kun 'byung dpag bsam shing chen te// dngos grub 'bras stsol nor 'chang gter gyi bdag /dbang gi las mdzad gnod sbyin dzam+bha la// gter bdag dbang ldan khyed la phyag 'tshal bstod// gzhan yang dpa' bo dhā ki mkha' 'gro ging*// dam can bka' srung gter bdag la sogs pa// pad+ma'i spyan sngar thugs dam zhal bzhes pa'i// dam tshig gter bdag rnams la bdag bstod do// de nas 'dzab skul ni/ hūm̐/ 'ja' 'od thig le 'od zer 'phro ba'i klong*// pad+ma nyi zla ma chags gdan steng du// rje btsun chen po pad+ma gu ru la// mi 'khrugs rdo rje spyan ras gzigs dbang dang*// rdo rje gro lod mkha' 'gro seng ge'i gdong*// rigs bdag tshe dpag gnod sbyin dzaṃ lha sogs// dgyes par bskor te 'dzum pa'i mdangs dang bcas// zhal nas snying po 'dzab kyi rang sgra sgrog /spros pas rgyal ba mnyes pa'i mchod pas mnyes// bsdus pas dngos grub thams cad bdag la thim// ma gsal bar du bsnyen cing 'bad de bsgrub// ma 'grub bar du ting 'dzin mi btang ngo*/ hrīḥpad+ma gu ru badz+ra sa man+ta sa tri lo ke shwa ra badz+ra lo ka ā yur+dz+nyā na ḍā ki siṃ ha mu kha dzam+bha la kā ya wā ka tsit+ta sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐/ shān+tiṃ puṣ+ṭiṃ wa shaṃ mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭaḥ gsum pa rjes kyi las 'grigs la dang po tshogs bsang sbyang byin gyis brlab pa ni/

hūm̐/ rang byung bhan+dha yangs shing rgya che'i nang*// tshogs rdzas 'dod yon bza' btung 'bag btsog rnams// rang nyid lha yi thugs ka'i 'od zer las// raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gis bsregs sbyangs bkrus par gyur// slar yang lha yi thugs ka'i 'od zer nas// oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.āḥyi 'phro 'du las// rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas 'od zhu rdzas la thim// gnyis med bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.āḥ de nas tshogs la spyan 'dren pa ni/ tshogs phud dang po ni/ hūm̐/ bde chen mnyam yangs thugs dam lha tshogs rnams// gnas 'dir spyan 'dren 'dod yon tshogs mchod bzhes// thugs dam dgyes bskang sgrub mchog mched lcam la// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub bstsal du gsol// rtsa sngags sham bur/ ga ṇa tsakra pū tsa la khā hi/ tshogs bar pa bshags pa ni/ hūm̐/ sngon byung dus nas da lta'i bar dag tu// bdag cag ma rig lus ngag yid gsum gyis// rtsa ba yan lag 'gal 'khrul ci mchis pa// zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pas bshags par bgyi/ hrīḥpad+ma gu ru badz+ra sa ma ya hoḥ tha ma bsgral mchod ni/ hūm̐/ gtum drag dpal chen rdo rje gro bo lod// g.yas pa'i phyag na rdo rje rtse lnga gdengs// g.yon pas phur bus dgra bgegs don snying gzir// log 'dren dgra bgegs rdul phran bzhin du rlogs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru rdo rje gro bo lod lo ka dgra bgegs gnod byed 'byung po mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa: yaṃ rbad/ hrīḥ pad+ma gu ru zhes pa nas/ dzaṃ bha la sa pa ri wā ra dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag rus pa la kha raṃ khā hi/ de nas tshogs kyi skong ba ni/ hūm̐/ gsang chen dur khrod rol pa'i dkyil 'khor 'dir// yang gsang dkyil 'khor sgrub rdzas mchod rdzas bshams// gang des rtsa gsum lha tshogs thugs dam bskang*// rnal 'byor nyams chag thams cad so sor bshags// bshags pa bya ba ni/ hūm̐/ chos sku skye med yang gsang don gyi lha// skong dang bskang bya bshags dang bshags byed med// skye med rang byung gdod nas lhan skyes te// rtsa gsum thugs dam lha tshogs thugs dam bskang*//

de nas tshogs drang zhing blang ba ni/ hrīḥ gdod nas rnam dag ming tsam med pas na/ gtsang dang dme ba'i tha snyad kun dang bral// rang byung rdzas mchog dgyes skong chen po 'di// spang blang gnyis su med par rol tu gsol// ces pas drang*/ hoḥ chos rnams bde chen ngo mtshar gcig pa la// gzung dang 'dzin pa'i mtshan ma kun dang bral// ye shes rdzas mchog du ma ro gcig ngang*// gnyis med bde ba chen por rol par bya// a la la hoḥ de nas tshogs lhag ni/ hrīḥ dang po phud bdag rtsa gsum thugs dam lha// bar du tshogs mchod 'khor bcas mchod pa'i rdzas// tha ma phud lhag bshal chu'i mchod pa 'di// dpal gyi bka' nyan dhā ki'i lhag sdud rnams// bzhes la sngon gyi dam bca' khas blangs bzhin// zhi rgyas dbang drag 'gug sreg mnan gzir sogs// bcol pa'i phrin las ma lus grub par mdzod// uts+tshiṣ+ṭa ba liṃ ta khā hi/ de nas thugs dam gnad nas bskul ba ni/ hūm̐/ chos sku skye med longs sku rang bzhin rdzogs// sprul skus don mdzad 'gro don thabs kyis 'dul// rtsa gsum thugs dam lha tshogs skur bzhengs la// gnas 'dir byon la dbang skur byin gyis rlobs// bdag ni bla med byang chub mchog sgrub cing*// yang gsang bskyed rdzogs nyams su len pa la// phyi nang gdon bgegs dgra 'dre mi mthun pa// dug gsum dug lnga log lta gnyis snang sogs// dbyings su sgrol la phyam brdal chen por mdzod// bskyed rdzogs zung 'brel ting 'dzin gding thob cing*// snang bzhi mthar phyin nyin mtshan rnal 'byor don// ye grol klong yangs 'od phung chen po'i mchog /tshe 'dir rtogs pa'i phrin las mdzad du gsol// de nas chad mtho bya ba ni/ hūm̐/ chos sku dpal chen che mchog he ru ka /longs sku zhi khro rab 'byams lha yi tshogs// sprul sku pad 'byung mnga' bdag yab sras dang*// brgyud 'dzin gter ston rig 'dzin sprul sku yis// dus tshigs gsum du rtsa gsum lha tshogs kyi// dkyil 'khor zhal phyes smin grol bkod pa yi// bka' srung gter srung dam can rgya mtsho yis/

khas blangs dam bca' tha tshig bor ba bzhin// dus 'dir sngags 'chang rnal 'byor bdag cag gis// bskul zhing phrin las deng 'dir bcol ba'i dus// mkho dgu'i gtor ma dam rdzas 'di bzhes la// bdag cag yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa yi// nad gdon bar chad dgra bgegs nyer 'tshe zlog /tshe dpal longs spyod gang bsam 'grub pa dang*// bla med byang chub thob pa'i phrin las mdzod//

de nas brtan ma skyong ba ni/ hūm̐/ phyi yi skyong ma brtan ma bcu gnyis tshogs// nang gi skyong ma dbang phyug nyi shu brgyad// gsang ba'i skyong ma dhā ki sde lnga'i tshogs// sngon tshe slob dpon pad+ma'i spyan snga ru/ khas blangs dam bca' gnyan po ji bzhin du// gtor ma'i bshal chu bdud rtsir byin brlabs 'dis/ khyed rnams dgyes bskangs phrin las rnam bzhi yi// don rnams ma lus dus 'dir 'grub par mdzod// de nas rta bro ni/ hūm̐/ gdug pa'i zhing bcu bsgral ba yi// phung khams skye mched ma lus par// rtsa gsum thugs dam lha tshogs kyis// dug lnga 'joms pa'i bro brdungs pas// bro ni 'du 'bral med pa'i bro// tshig ni snying po 'dzab kyi glu// gnyis med chos kyi dbyings su thim// oṃ s+t+wam+bha ya rak+sha nan/ de nas lhag chad kha skong ni/ hūm̐/ rtsa gsum thugs dam lha tshogs dkyil 'khor du// sgrub rdzas ma tshang mchod rdzas ma 'byor pa// sngags nyams cho ga lhag chad gyur pa rnams// thugs dam dkyil 'khor lha la bzod par gsol// de nas gshegs su gsol ba ni/ kye ma/ rtsa gsum thugs dam lha tshogs rnams// de ring nyid du gshegs nas kyang*// thugs rjes sems can don nyid du// slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol// dkyil 'khor bsdu zhing rdzogs rim ni/ hūm̐/ rang rig sems kyi dkyil 'khor du// thugs dam lha tshogs ma lus pa// dwangs pa'i mtsho la gza' skar bzhin// gsal stong chen por mngon du shar// chu la chu bur thim pa dang*// nam mkha'i 'ja' tshon yal ba bzhin// skye med chos kyi dbyings su bzhag / de nas smon lam ni/ bdag gis 'gro ba kun don du// thugs dam lha tshogs bsgrubs nas su// dge ba ci dang ci mchis pas// bla med byang chub myur thob shog / de nas bkra shis ni/ hrīḥ bkra shis dpag bsam shing gi sdong po la// dgos 'dod nor bu'i 'bras bu mchog tu smin// 'gro kun bdud rtsi'i ro yis tshim mdzad pa// byin rlabs bla ma rnams kyi bkra shis shog

/bkra shis gangs ri lhun sdug chags pa la// 'gro la dgos 'dod chu bo'i rgyun chen 'bebs// tsha gdung nyon mongs gdung ba sel mdzad pa// yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs bkra shis shog /bkra shis ye shes me chen rab 'bar mdzad// me yi tshwa tshwa rab gdung 'phro ba yis// dgra bgegs bud shing ma lus sreg mdzad pa// mkha' 'gro dam can rnams kyi bkra shis shog /bkra shis sa gzhi brtan pa'i zhing sa la// don grub 'bras bu lo thog smin mdzad pas// skye 'gro sems can bde bar 'tsho byed pa// yangs pa'i rgyal khams bde ba'i bkra shis shog / ces slob dpon pad+ma saṃ bha was/ mnga' bdag chos skyong ba'i rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan yab sras la gdams pa'i thugs dam rgyun gyi nyams len gyi las byang mdor bsdus pa zhig dgos zhes/ snying po'i don la mi phyed pa'i snying stobs 'chang zhing*/ bskyed rdzogs kyi don thugs nyams su len par spro ba zur mkhar shar phyogs pa rta mgrin tshe dbang gis bskul ba las/ rdzogs chen pa gar gyi dbang phyug rtsal gyis stan thog gcig tu bkod pa'i yi ge pa ni kun dga' paṇa chen zhes pas bgyis pa'o// shubhaṃ/ bkra shis so// //
